items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Justin, he's a guitar player, he's still around, somewhere around in the water.

ctx.x: Before the house break down. Before that, we don't know anything about it. Yeah.

And mostly all of Dixieland, old times. The majority of them are dead and handy. Yeah. Fields and Louis and all of them. See, I used to play with them a lot, you know, Dixieland at that time, because really when I started playing the music that I was playing nobody knew what it was. You know what I mean? And right now they really don't tell me what kind of music I play, you know what I mean? I was working with Dave Vassalemur and them, and they didn't know either, so they just say, well, just call it the pitum,…

Yeah, I know a guitar. I hadn't seen him in a long while though, but I'll take that back, I saw him this past year sometime. Yeah, I saw him a couple of months ago. Yeah, he was playing down, I remember a couple of years ago he was playing at the Dutrop, I think, where is it?
